newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ June qtr expenditure GDP unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NZ June qtr expenditure GDP unchanged.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand on Friday released unofficial estimates of expenditure on real gross domestic product for the quarter ended June 30, 1996, at constant 1991-92 prices (revised from figures in brackets).
Seasonally-adjusted percentage change from previous qtr at constant 1991/92 prices:
June 1996 yr Mar 1996 yr June 1995 yr

Note - A Reuters survey of economists had forecast real seasonally adjusted GDP would rise 0.6 percent in the quarter for a seasonally adjusted annual average rise of 1.3 percent and an actual annual rise of 1.1 percent.
